notes.title: 21/03/2022 - Update 1
notes.content:
Quality of life update
 - Multi-craft sets from your bots (1, 10, 100 or 1,000 sets at a time)
 - Deposit gems onto your bots(1,000, 10,000, 100,000 or 1,000,000 gems at a time)
 - Withdraw gems from your bots(1,000, 10,000, 100,000 or 1,000,000 gems at a time)

notes.title: Patch 1 - 19/03/2022
notes.content:
- Fixed typo on the "Misc Bots" page

 - Fixed 3 achievements that would not unlock

 - Capped the buy and sell prices that the user can input, going over or under these prices will default your input price to the caps, this will prevent the player from buying stock at 1 gem or selling stock at 1,000,000 gems as an example
